# DMROC

Another name for ROC.

## Syntax

```text
DMROC testvars BY state(value) [/subcommands of ROC].
```

The same command as ROC, with the same subcommands and defaults.

## Example

```text
DMROC propensity BY bought (1) /PLOT=CURVE.
```

`statscraft help DMROC` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
